answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The sable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the copper. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
